Title: Retirement: Azure HDInsight – Enterprise Security Package

Body.Content:
Microsoft will no longer provides support for  ESP (Enterprise Security Package) version of Azure HDInsight from 31-July-2026.   For more details on impact please refer to Supported HDInsight versions.

Required Action    

To avoid potential service disruptions and data loss, you are required to migrate to alternative offerings such as Microsoft Fabric. 

More Information   

If you have questions, get answers from community experts in Microsoft Q&A. If you have a support plan and you need technical help, create a support request.
